verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of happiness.
The happiness of laypeople, and the happiness of renunciates.
These are the two kinds of happiness.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sukhānaṁ yadidaṁ pabbajitasukhan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of happiness is the happiness of renunciates.”
